description: Find published animated maps on Moving Polygons (history, wars, empires, borders, epidemics, sea ice…) by words in their title or description and/or a year they cover. Returns links to the interactive map, its text version and its article.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. 'Ottoman', 'Holy Roman Empire', 'Ukraine war'

year.description: Only maps whose timeline includes this year; negative for BC (-44 = 44 BC)

name: search_maps
title: Search published maps
